Metadata.Time Period: Current as of the last update
Metadata.Data Owner: Department of Buildings and Department of Law

columns.name: DEFENDANT OWNER
columns.description: A list of the building owners who are named as defendants in the code enforcement proceeding as of the owner list date. Owners are listed one month after the building list date.

columns.name: ADDRESS
columns.description: Primary address of building (used for geocoding and other geographic information).

columns.name: SECONDARY ADDRESS
columns.description: An alternative address that could be used to describe building location. This was not used for any geocoding.

columns.name: TERTIARY ADDRESS
columns.description: An alternative address that could be used to describe building location. This was not used for any geocoding.

columns.name: CIRCUIT COURT CASE NUMBER
columns.description: Case number for the Cook County Circuit Court

columns.name: BUILDING LIST DATE
columns.description: The date of the building list for this record.

columns.name: OWNER LIST DATE
columns.description: The date of the owner list for this record.

columns.name: COMMUNITY AREA
columns.description: The name of the community area. For context, see: http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Community_areas_in_Chicago

columns.name: COMMUNITY AREA NUMBER
columns.description: The ID that corresponds with COMMUNITY AREA in this dataset. For context, see: http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Community_areas_in_Chicago

columns.name: WARD
columns.description: The number of the ward (city council district) as of the building  list date

columns.name: X_COORDINATE
columns.description: The east-west coordinate defined in feet, based on NAD 83 - State Plane Eastern IL

columns.name: Y_COORDINATE
columns.description: The north-south coordinate defined in feet, based on NAD 83 - State Plane Eastern IL

columns.name: LONGITUDE
columns.description: The longitude of the building (based on the ADDRESS column).

columns.name: LATITUDE
columns.description: The latitude of the building (based on the ADDRESS column).

columns.name: LOCATION
columns.description: The location of the building (based on the ADDRESS column) in a format that allows for mapping and other geographic analysis on this portal.

columns.name: RECORD ID
columns.description: A unique identifier for the record.  A record is considered an updated version of a previously existing record if it has the same CIRCUIT COURT CASE NUMBER and BUILDING LIST DATE. This will most commonly happen when the DEFENDANT OWNER value is added a month after the record is first published.

columns.name: Historical Wards 2003-2015 2
columns.description: This column was automatically created in order to record in what polygon from the dataset 'Historical Wards 2003-2015' (awaf-s7ux) the point in column 'location' is located.  This enables the creation of region maps (choropleths) in the visualization canvas and data lens.
